phase_policy.boundary_rule: A window belongs to a phase only when its complete [window_start, window_end] interval is contained in that phase. Other windows are excluded from primary evaluation.

task_policy.system_detection: Aggregate service anomaly scores by window_start; normal is negative and fault is positive.
task_policy.affected_service_detection: Normal service-windows are negative; fault windows for affected_component are positive. Other services during fault are not treated as negatives.
task_policy.localization: Rank services by anomaly score during pure fault windows and evaluate the rank of affected_component.

notes: Warmup is excluded before model fitting.
Recovery is secondary and does not determine the primary model selection.
The empty-namespace identity stratum is preserved for quality analysis and is not merged by service name.
